text:
Revenue is plausibly the sum of order_items.product_price (price at the item grain). Use certified join order_item_to_product.

SELECT p.product_type, SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_type
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 500
